line.en: the annual exchange between two jazz clubs, two musicians from each. doors at 20:00, music at 21:00. chf 20 full price.

sparks.why: Porta Jazz and AMR concert at the AMR (rue des Alpes 10), Sat 14.11, doors 20:00, start 21:00, CHF 20, per geneve.com (https://www.geneve.com/en/events/porta-jazz-and-amr).
